name: 73120 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73120 (Oklahoma City) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73120 (Oklahoma City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73120 (Oklahoma City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
